title: Treadmill Training and Orthotic Use in Infants With Down Syndrome
brief_summary: This study determines the effect of orthotic use in combination with treadmill training on the development of gross motor skills and walking onset in infants with Down syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Trisomy 21
* Able to pull to stand but not walk

Exclusion Criteria:

* Additional developmental diagnoses
* Uncorrected vision or hearing impairments
* Previous orthotic intervention
* Previous treadmill intervention
